name: Berggasthof Bavaria
beschreibung: Berggasthof Bavaria is nestled in the Tyrolean mountains, offering accommodations infused with regional charm. The guest rooms are simply and practically furnished. The inn features a traditional dining room serving delicious Tyrolean specialties. From the sun terrace, guests enjoy sweeping views of the surrounding peaks. The mountain inn serves as a great base for hiking excursions and ski touring. The kitchen places a strong emphasis on locally sourced ingredients. The ambiance is rustic, authentic, and welcoming.
